forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {寄与|きよ}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: Contributing to or playing a role in achieving something positive. A formal word for making a meaningful contribution to a cause, field, or outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄与|きよ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{寄与|きよ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This research greatly contributed to the advancement of medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄与|きよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: His contribution to the local economy was highly evaluated, and he received an award.

notes:
{寄与|きよ} combines {寄|き} (to approach, to contribute) and {与|よ} (to give). It is a formal word used in written and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄与|きよ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to contribute to society)
- ⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄与|きよ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to contribute to development)
- {寄与|きよ}⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree of contribution)
- {寄与|きよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (significant contribution)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寄与|きよ} vs. ⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧: Both mean "contribution," but {寄与|きよ} is more formal and literary. ⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧ is the more common, everyday word. {寄与|きよ} often appears in academic, legal, and official writing.
